flows:
Navigate to https://mlyfo.vercel.app/signin?demo=1 then Click the "Sign in" button
Go to https://mlyfo.vercel.app/app/shield
Type "0x7a3f9cE5b801Dd3fA7426C9e0B1f8a5d3e27c4b9" into the "Paste a Solana, Ethereum or Base address" field
Click "Check address"
Assert the result says "Blocked"
Assert the result says it looks like Ada (Base)’s saved address but isn’t
Assert the result is labelled as an Ethereum and Base address

remark: click: Clicking the Sign in button in the sign-in form
type: Typing the address into the Paste an address field
analyze: the result is labelled as a Base address
assert: the result says it looks like Ada (Base)’s saved address but isn’t

summary:
The address check sent a valid-looking 0x address through Solana validation, so it never compared it with Ada (Base)'s saved address or showed the expected Ethereum and Base result.
Update Shield's address detection so 0x addresses are handled as Ethereum and Base addresses before any Solana validation, then run the saved-contact look-alike comparison.
evidence: error_ui_text: Blocked. This isn’t a valid Solana address.
evidence: objective_contradiction: POST https://mlyfo.vercel.app/api/shield/address -> 200
one_liner: Shield blocked the entered address as an invalid Solana address instead of identifying its Ethereum and Base look-alike risk.
reason: Checkpoint assertion failed: "the result says it looks like Ada (Base)’s saved address but isn’t"
